title: select last resort
name: Select last resort
rule: Select is last resort on public services; ask questions that shrink the list first.
pass_when: Public-service flow avoids a long select until questions have shrunk the list, or select is not used.
fail_when: A long public-service select is the first/only way to choose, with no shrinking questions.
overview: On public services, treat select as a last resort after questions shrink the list.
apply_when: Choosing among many options in a public-service form flow.
not_when: Not for tiny fixed lists already short enough, or non-public admin tools.
agent_hint: Ask shrinking questions first; avoid a long public-service select as the first step.
description: On public services, a long select should be a last resort. Ask questions that shrink the list first, or avoid select entirely when another pattern fits better. Long selects are hard to scan and easy to mis-choose on public flows. Fail when a long public-service select is the first or only way to choose with no shrinking questions beforehand. Prefer progressive questions that reduce options before any remaining select.
do_not_claim: A house option-count cutoff (see NN/g / Polar choice cutoffs). Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.match_control_and_size`, `dropdown_chooser`, `combo_box`, `offer_choices_not_only_text`. Dual-cite DS cutoffs; no house number.
